tos.title: Terms of Service
tos.body:
Mufasa Safaris & Tours is operated by Cyber PolCo, based in Windhoek, Namibia, running tours in Namibia, the Democratic Republic of Congo, Zambia and Zimbabwe.

How bookings work: there are no guest accounts. Browse a package and pick a departure date, or tell us what you have in mind through Plan My Trip and we'll follow up with a quotation. Your booking reference, paired with the tour lead's last name, is the only way to look up your booking again — keep it somewhere safe.

Pricing & payment: every price is computed by us and shown to you before you pay. Card payments are handled entirely on our payment provider's own secure hosted page — we never see or store your card details. Payment is a 40% deposit and the balance later, unless full payment upfront is required (booking close to departure carries a lead-time surcharge, always shown before you pay).

Your responsibilities: give us accurate names and passport/ID details for every traveler, and make sure everyone booked is fit for the activities included (for example, gorilla trekking has its own health rules). You're responsible for meeting the entry requirements of every country on your itinerary.

Visa assistance: this is a paid add-on where we help you prepare and submit your application — we don't control the outcome, and visa assistance fees and any government visa fee are never refundable, whatever happens to your application.

Liability [NEEDS LEGAL REVIEW]: travel in the destinations we operate in carries inherent risk, including from terrain, wildlife, and regional security conditions. By booking, you accept these risks; we carry the insurance and safety practices required of a licensed operator, but this section needs a qualified legal review before it should be treated as final.

Governing law [NEEDS LEGAL REVIEW]: these terms are intended to be governed by the laws of Namibia — pending confirmation from a qualified lawyer.

We may update these terms from time to time; the version on this page is always the current one.

privacy.title: Privacy & What We Collect
privacy.body:
There are no tourist accounts on this site — nothing is tied to a login. What we hold about you is tied to your booking.

What we collect: the tour lead's contact details (name, email, phone); for every traveler, name, age, nationality and passport/ID number; health-related information you choose to share with us, like allergies or disabilities, so we and your guide can plan safely; an emergency contact; and your payment status (never your card number — that never reaches us).

Why we collect it: to plan and run your trip, to apply for a visa on your behalf when you've asked us to, to meet the entry and travel regulations of the countries you're visiting, and to reach you about your booking.

Who we share it with: our payment provider, to process payment; visa facilitators and the local hotels, guides and drivers actually running your trip, only as far as each of them needs to know; and our messaging providers, to send you booking updates by WhatsApp, SMS or email.

Where it's stored: on servers based in the EU.

How long we keep it: bookings are kept while relevant to your trip and automatically removed some time after they close. Some records, like passport copies, don't yet have an automatic deletion schedule — contact us and we'll remove them by hand.

Your rights: you can ask us to access, correct or delete what we hold about you at any time by getting in touch — there's no self-service option for this yet, so a real person handles every request directly.

A note on sensitive information: anything you tell us about allergies or disabilities is used only to keep you safe on tour, and is only ever shared with the people actually running your trip.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.body:
We keep this simple — there are three cookies on this site, and no third-party advertising or tracking cookies at all.

One keeps you signed in while you're making a booking (necessary — this is what lets a multi-step booking remember who you are between pages).

One remembers your language choice, English or French (necessary).

One is optional, and only set if you agree to it from the banner at the bottom of the page: an anonymous id we use to see where guests drop off partway through Plan My Trip, so we can improve it. It's never linked to your name, and it's automatically deleted from our systems after 30 days.

You can accept or decline the optional cookie from the banner at any time, or clear cookies from your browser's own settings whenever you like.

cancellation.title: Cancellation & Refund Policy
cancellation.body:
You can cancel a booking yourself at any time from Find My Booking — look up your booking, confirm your email and tell us why, and your refund is calculated automatically using the table below.

60 or more days before departure: full refund of what you've paid, minus your deposit.
30 to 59 days before departure: 50% of what you've paid.
14 to 29 days before departure: 25% of what you've paid.
Fewer than 14 days before departure, or a no-show: no refund.

Your deposit is 40% of the total price. It reflects costs we commit to hotels, vehicles and guides on your behalf in advance, so it's the one part of your payment that's never refunded once paid.

If we're the ones who have to cancel your trip — for example because of a safety advisory in the area you're visiting — you get a full refund with no deductions.

Visa assistance fees and any government visa fee are never refundable, whatever the outcome of your visa application.

Once your cancellation is confirmed, our team processes your refund back to your original payment method.

WeatherPage.title: Weather where we operate
WeatherPage.subhead: Current conditions for our main towns, grouped by country — tap a town for a forecast and seasonal travel notes.

WeatherTownPage.liveDataUnavailable: Live weather temporarily unavailable — please check back shortly.

WeatherSeasonalNotes.windhoek: Semi-arid, mild year-round. Short rainy season Nov-Apr (afternoon thunderstorms), driest and coolest May-Sep.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.swakopmund: Coastal desert climate -- cool and often foggy year-round, rarely hot. Morning fog is common regardless of season.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.walvis-bay: Similar coastal climate to nearby Swakopmund -- mild, dry, frequent morning fog, minimal rainfall year-round.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.luderitz: Cool, windy coastal desert town -- strong afternoon winds are common; pack a windbreaker regardless of month.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.etosha-national-park: Best game viewing in the dry season (May-Oct) when animals concentrate at waterholes; wet season (Nov-Apr) is greener but wildlife disperses.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.sesriem: Hot desert days year-round, cold nights May-Aug. Sunrise visits to the dunes avoid the worst midday heat.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.katima-mulilo: Wetter, sub-tropical climate (Zambezi region) -- rainy season Nov-Apr can affect some rural access roads.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.kinshasa: Tropical climate -- two rainy seasons (roughly Oct-Dec and Mar-May), driest Jun-Sep.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.lubumbashi: Higher-altitude, milder climate than western DRC -- distinct dry season May-Sep, rains Oct-Apr.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.kolwezi: Similar highland climate to Lubumbashi -- dry season May-Sep is the easiest time to travel.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.mbuji-mayi: Tropical savanna climate -- a clearer dry season (May-Sep) than western DRC, heavier rains Oct-Apr.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.matadi: Hot, tropical -- rainy season roughly Oct-May, a cooler dry season Jun-Sep.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.boma: Coastal tropical climate, similar pattern to nearby Matadi -- driest Jun-Sep.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.goma: Tempered by altitude (Lake Kivu region) -- generally mild, rains most pronounced Sep-May. Check current travel conditions with us before booking.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.bukavu: Similar mild, high-altitude Lake Kivu climate to Goma -- rains most pronounced Sep-May. Check current travel conditions with us before booking.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.kisangani: Equatorial -- hot and humid year-round with rain possible in any month; no sharply defined dry season.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.livingstone: Victoria Falls is at its most powerful (and mistiest) Mar-May after the rains; lowest water and clearest views Sep-Dec.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.lusaka: Rainy season Nov-Apr, cool dry season May-Aug, hot dry season Sep-Oct.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.mfuwe: South Luangwa walking safaris run in the dry season (roughly May-Oct); many camps close during the wettest months.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.siavonga: Hot Lake Kariba climate -- Sep-Nov is the hottest stretch before the rains arrive.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.chipata: Similar seasonal pattern to Mfuwe -- rains Nov-Apr, dry and best for travel May-Oct.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.victoria-falls: Falls at their most powerful Mar-May; lowest water and best photography conditions Sep-Dec.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.harare: Rainy season Nov-Mar, mild dry winter Jun-Aug, hot build-up Sep-Oct.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.bulawayo: Similar pattern to Harare -- dry season (Apr-Oct) is the easiest time to visit Matobo Hills.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.hwange-dete: Dry season (roughly Jul-Oct) brings the best game viewing as animals concentrate around waterholes.
WeatherSeasonalNotes.masvingo: Rainy season Nov-Mar, dry and mild Apr-Oct -- the easier stretch for visiting Great Zimbabwe.

StaffTaxRates.title: Tax Rates
StaffTaxRates.intro: Per-country VAT/sales tax applied to every invoice (BR-01). Add a new row for a new rate, or edit an existing one in place — an edit recomputes every existing package and tailor-made booking price.
StaffTaxRates.removeConfirm: Remove this tax rate? This cannot be undone.
StaffTaxRates.reapplyBanner: Rate updated. Packages recomputed: {packagesUpdated} updated, {packagesSkipped} skipped. Tailor-made bookings recomputed: {bookingsUpdated} updated, {bookingsSkipped} skipped.

StaffPlatformRate.title: Platform Rate
StaffPlatformRate.intro: The platform's own commission on every online payment processed, shown as an informational split on each invoice — it never changes what the customer pays. Add a new row for a new rate, or edit the existing one in place — an edit recomputes every existing package and tailor-made booking price.
StaffPlatformRate.removeConfirm: Remove this platform rate? This cannot be undone.
StaffPlatformRate.reapplyBanner: Rate updated. Packages recomputed: {packagesUpdated} updated, {packagesSkipped} skipped. Tailor-made bookings recomputed: {bookingsUpdated} updated, {bookingsSkipped} skipped.

StaffClients.title: Clients
StaffClients.intro: Every client contact record on file — from a guest browsing packages, a `/plan-my-trip` request, or a booking created manually here. None of these are staff/login accounts; the email/phone exist only for booking notifications.
StaffClients.name: Name

StaffPermissions.title: Permission matrix
StaffPermissions.intro: Toggle checkboxes below, then press "Save changes" to apply them — nothing is written until you save. SUPERADMIN itself never appears here — it's a fixed, permanent role that can never be edited or locked out of the system.

StaffUsers.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete {name}? Unlike Deactivate, this cannot be undone.

StaffCms.title: Site Content
StaffCms.intro: Editable text for the guest /about page and /faq list. English and French are independent rows, not a translated mirror of each other — edit each locale on its own.
StaffCms.noAboutContent: No About content set for this locale yet.
StaffCms.removeFaqConfirm: Remove this FAQ entry? This cannot be undone.
StaffCms.imageUploadNotice: General-purpose upload — returns a public URL, not yet wired to any specific page (no licensed destination photography exists yet). Copy the URL and use it wherever needed.
StaffCms.heroIntro: The homepage's rotating hero carousel — text, image or video, and color overlay per slide. Add, remove, and reorder slides freely.
StaffCms.removeSiteConfirm: Remove this gallery site? This cannot be undone.
StaffCms.noMediaYet: No image or video chosen yet.
StaffCms.chooseMediaFile: Choose an image or video to replace the current media.
StaffCms.mediaUploadError: Upload failed — check the file type/size and try again.
StaffCms.removeSlideConfirm: Remove this hero slide? This cannot be undone.
StaffCms.galleryIntro: A photo or video per destination site. A site with nothing uploaded yet shows the illustrated placeholder.
StaffCms.contactGeneralDetailsLabel: Free text (e.g. a general email, WhatsApp number, or hours) — hidden on the guest page until filled in
StaffCms.partnersIntro: The homepage's scrolling partner/client strip. A partner with no logo uploaded yet shows our own mark and its name instead.
StaffCms.removePartnerConfirm: Remove this partner? This cannot be undone.
StaffCms.choosePartnerLogoFile: Choose a logo image to replace the current one.
StaffCms.socialLinksIntro: The footer's social icons. A link with no platform or URL set yet is hidden from the guest site.
StaffCms.removeSocialLinkConfirm: Remove this social link? This cannot be undone.
StaffCms.footerLegalIntro: The footer's closing copyright line is a template you control. Use '{year}' for the current year (always live, never frozen) and '{link}' for where the editable link below appears — e.g. © '{year}' Mufasa Safaris & Tours, a '{link}' Product. Leave the template blank to keep that default line.
StaffCms.mapCountriesIntro: Which countries get their own highlight color and hover snapshot on the homepage map. Pick any African country, then fill in its capital, languages, currency, population, and area.
StaffCms.removeCountryConfirm: Remove this country from the map? This cannot be undone.

StaffCmsEmail.intro: Edit the wording of every automated email. Layout, colors, the logo, and the subject line stay fixed -- only the eyebrow label, heading, and body text below are editable. A blank field falls back to the default shown here. Use the {{placeholders}} shown under a template's body exactly as written -- they're replaced with real data (booking reference, amount, etc.) when the email is sent.

StaffCoupons.title: Coupons
StaffCoupons.intro: Percentage-discount codes applied to an invoice before payment. Codes are generated automatically.
StaffCoupons.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete this coupon? It can no longer be applied to any invoice, and its redemption history is removed too. This cannot be undone.

StaffLateBookingRate.title: Late Booking Rate
StaffLateBookingRate.intro: When a guest's travel date is within the threshold, only full payment is available, with a surcharge added on top. Add a new row for a new rate, or edit the existing one in place -- unlike Tax/Platform Rate, editing here never retroactively changes an existing booking or invoice.
StaffLateBookingRate.noneYet: No late booking rate configured yet.
StaffLateBookingRate.removeConfirm: Remove this late booking rate? This cannot be undone.
